content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIASL Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.aiasl.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 07-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIASL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to receive applications for the AIASL Chief Financial Officer and Deputy Chief Financial Officer posts is 07 October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must be Qualified Chartered Accountants (CA) from ICAI or Qualified Cost Accountants (CMA) from ICMAI with a valid membership to be eligible for these positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the AIASL CFO and Dy.CFO positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for both the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and Deputy Chief Financial Officer (Dy.CFO) posts is 62 years.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available in this AIASL recruitment?
faq.answer: AI Airport Services (AIASL) has announced a total of 2 vacancies for the posts of Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and Deputy Chief Financial Officer (Dy.CFO).

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for AIASL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/- for General/OBC and PwBD candidates. SC/ST candidates are exempted from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the CFO and Dy.CFO posts?
faq.answer: The Chief Financial Officer (CFO) can expect a salary between Rs. 1,60,000 to Rs. 2,00,000 per month, while the Deputy Chief Financial Officer (Dy.CFO) will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 1,20,000 to Rs. 1,50,000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for AIASL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process for AIASL Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it via post to the address mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What are the selection criteria for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for the AIASL CFO and Dy.CFO roles includes a screening of applications, followed by a personal interview, and finally, document verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of AI Airport Services (AIASL), which is www.aiasl.in. Links are also provided in the Important Links section.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The recruitment for the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and Deputy Chief Financial Officer (Dy.CFO) posts in AIASL is on a contractual basis.
